root_cause.text: The Intel VT-d scalable mode IOTLB invalidation path used `pci_dev_is_disconnected()` to skip ATS invalidation for inaccessible devices, but this check does not detect link-down caused by faults, leading to hard-lockups when invalidating a device whose PCIe link has failed.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE and commit message state: "Commit 4fc82cd907ac ... relies on pci_dev_is_disconnected() to skip ATS invalidation for safely-removed devices, but it does not cover link-down caused by faults, which can still hard-lock the system." The patch changes the condition to `!pci_device_is_present(to_pci_dev(dev))` to correctly handle both disconnection and link-down scenarios.
